findings.claim: The lab directions reveal the completed implementation for every task: exact declarations are supplied for the viewport, Flexbox, Grid, both media queries, named areas, and overflow fix. The public test names and failure messages repeat many of those declarations. A learner can copy the answer without deciding which property or layout rule satisfies the goal, so the 62-minute lab does not independently evidence the listed implementation objectives and conflicts with the direction not to reveal reasoning answers.
findings.recommendation: Keep the numbered file/location, expected behavior, and done/test criteria, but replace completed rules with goal-oriented prompts and, where needed, syntax-only hints or partially completed scaffolds. Make public failure messages identify the unmet outcome without spelling out the full declaration. Preserve enough feedback for retry after a failed attempt.
